strings.name: RJ Scaringe
strings.summary: American engineer and entrepreneur Robert Joseph Scaringe, known as RJ Scaringe, founded Rivian after studying mechanical engineering. He leads teams developing electric pickups, SUVs and commercial delivery vehicles and serves on industrial robotics and micromobility boards. Products and manufacturing rely on teams and partners.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Unveiling, production and external deliveries are distinct, as are personal offices and corporate results. Driver-supervised functions are not driverless driving; future releases are not completed events.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Rivian, advancing electric pickup and commercial delivery vehicle development and contributing to transport electrification and automotive manufacturing change.
strings.facts.f1.label: Engineering education
strings.facts.f1.value: RPI mechanical engineering BS in 2005, MIT masters in 2007 and mechanical engineering PhD in 2009. Research concerned combustion engines, distinct from later EV entrepreneurship.
strings.facts.f2.label: Other company roles
strings.facts.f2.value: 2026 proxy lists him as chairman of Mind Robotics and Also. Mind later names Doug Field president; that title is not Scaringe’s.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Electrification and systems integration
strings.highlights.h1.text: Combines vehicle hardware, software and manufacturing for consumer and commercial markets; company platforms are not individual inventions.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Product direction changes
strings.highlights.h2.text: University interview recounts his team’s shift from sports cars to pickups and SUVs, emphasizing outdoor use and electrification.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Company reports R2 quarterly progress
strings.timeline.t1.text: Rivian says R2 led its vehicle lines in Q3 deliveries. The 19,248 total covers the entire company, not R2 alone.
strings.timeline.t2.title: R2 external customer deliveries begin
strings.timeline.t2.text: Later quarterly release confirms the date and Normal, Illinois production; distinct from employee deliveries or production start.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Rivian starts Nasdaq trading
strings.timeline.t3.text: Class A shares trade as RIVN; trading start is not IPO settlement or personal cash proceeds.
strings.timeline.t4.title: First R1T deliveries
strings.timeline.t4.text: Annual report records September R1T deliveries and December R1S deliveries; the earlier 2020 plan did not occur on schedule.
strings.timeline.t5.title: R1T and R1S unveiled
strings.timeline.t5.text: Team presents electric pickup and SUV at Los Angeles Auto Show; unveiling is distinct from later deliveries.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Becomes Rivian chairman
strings.timeline.t6.text: Adds chairmanship to founder, CEO and director roles; chair tenure does not begin in 2009.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Revises early vehicle direction
strings.timeline.t7.text: MIT retrospective describes reassessment of the sports-car plan and a shift to electric pickups and SUVs.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Founds Rivian as CEO
strings.timeline.t8.text: Starts automotive venture after his doctorate; proxy records CEO and director service since founding.
